candidate_commit: FILL-IN: the 40-character commit id of the candidate tested
spec_revision: FILL-IN: the specification revision in spec.lock
started_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone when the test or drill started
completed_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone when it finished

data.os_network_blocked: FILL-IN: true or false: Was networking disabled at the OS level for every offline run?
data.candidate_version: FILL-IN: text: App version of this release candidate (X.Y.Z)
data.supported_apps: FILL-IN: a list of strings: App versions still supported (comma-separated, e.g. 1.2.0,1.3.1); for the very first release, only its own version
data.platforms: FILL-IN: a list of strings: Platforms in the release (comma-separated, e.g. windows,macos)

runs.previous: FILL-IN: fresh or a supported version
runs.replay_before: FILL-IN: 64 lowercase hex: Mastery replay hash before upgrade (64 hex; fresh runs: hash after replay)
runs.replay_after: FILL-IN: 64 lowercase hex: Mastery replay hash after upgrade (64 hex)
runs.zero_egress: FILL-IN: true or false: Did the monitor record zero outbound connections?
runs.passed: FILL-IN: true or false: Did every step of the script pass on this run?
runs.steps: FILL-IN: a list of step names: Steps completed: 'all' or a comma list of all_kill_targets, failed_launch_rollback, first_run, guided, mock, pack_boundary, practice, redacted_export
runs.evidence_id: FILL-IN: the SHA-256 of this raw proof file, which is also listed in the index: this run's monitor log or recording

data.device: FILL-IN: Device or environment used: hardware class, model and asset label, OS version (or the staging environment name)
